steps.note: Opens the Single Stage create flow specified by the case.
Changes the initial event type to RFQ.
Provides the required event title so the event can be published.
Applies the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Adds a CYLINDER line item with the requested quantity; exact variant and location selection are not exposed by a catalog step.
Completes the RFQ pricing sheet before scheduling and publishing.
Adds one QA vendor so the event can receive a bid.
Confirms the event reached a real published project page.
Confirms the bid was accepted by the vendor portal.
Returns to the buyer portal before attempting the exchange-rate change.

args.goal: configure or open the event's multi-currency exchange-rate editor, change an exchange rate after the bid has been placed, and verify that Procol refuses the change with the message "Exchange rates cannot be updated after bids have been placed."

steps.note: Performs and verifies the buyer-side exchange-rate action that no dedicated catalog step can express.
